content.short: FalconX is a digital asset prime broker offering liquidity, financing and custody to institutions.
content.description: FalconX operates as a prime broker for institutional digital asset trading, bundling liquidity access, credit and financing, and custody into a single counterparty relationship. Hyperliquid's builder documentation lists it among the qualified custodians serving the network. Institutional participation in an on-chain venue generally waits on this kind of intermediary existing, since most funds cannot hold keys directly for mandate reasons.
